name: data_pages_tool
description: Data tool - Pages tool to perform actions like list pages, get page metadata, update page settings, create a page, bulk update page settings, manage branches (list, create, delete), and read or write JSON-LD schema markup for pages in bulk.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site whose pages are being updated. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

id.description: ID of the page to update. Required.

localeId.description: Secondary locale ID to write this item's changes to. Omit for the primary locale.

slug.description: URL slug for the page (the path segment).

draft.description: Whether the page is a draft (excluded from publishing).

parentFolderId.description: ID of the folder to nest the page under. null moves the page to the site root.

titleCopied.description: Whether the Open Graph title is copied from the SEO/page title.

descriptionCopied.description: Whether the Open Graph description is copied from the SEO/page description.

imageUrl.description: Raw Open Graph image URL (og:image). null unsets the image. Mutually exclusive with imageAssetId — provide at most one.

imageAssetId.description: Site asset ID to use as the Open Graph image. null unsets the image. Mutually exclusive with imageUrl — provide at most one.

openGraph.description: Open Graph metadata for the page.

jsonLdSchema.description: JSON-LD structured data as a raw string. null clears the page's existing JSON-LD schema markup.

bulk_update_pages.description: Updates settings for one or more pages in a site in a single request (write/side-effect: this updates existing pages; 1..100 pages per call). Each item targets a page by id and may set any subset of: localeId (write to a specific secondary locale), title, slug, draft, parentFolderId, seo, openGraph, and jsonLdSchema. parentFolderId nests the page under a folder; null moves it to the site root. For openGraph, imageUrl and imageAssetId are mutually exclusive (provide at most one); passing null for either unsets it. jsonLdSchema null clears the page's JSON-LD schema markup.

anyOf.description: Run bulk_update_pages: Updates settings for one or more pages in a site in a single request (write/side-effect: this updates existing pages; 1..100 pages per call). Each item targets a page by id and may set any subset of: localeId (write to a specific secondary locale), title, slug, draft, parentFolderId, seo, openGraph, and jsonLdSchema. parentFolderId nests the page under a folder; null moves it to the site root. For openGraph, imageUrl and imageAssetId are mutually exclusive (provide at most one); passing null for either unsets it. jsonLdSchema null clears the page's JSON-LD schema markup.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

localeId.description: Secondary locale ID. Omit for the primary locale.

jsonLdSchema.description: JSON-LD structured data as an object (e.g., { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "Article", ... }), a raw JSON string, or null to clear existing markup.

bulk_update_pages_schema_markup.description: Write or clear JSON-LD schema markup for one or more pages (1..25). Pass a 1-item array for a single page. Per-item: id (required), optional localeId, and jsonLdSchema (object, raw string, or null to clear). The action also accepts strings wrapped in <script type="application/ld+json">…</script>.

anyOf.description: Run bulk_update_pages_schema_markup: Write or clear JSON-LD schema markup for one or more pages (1..25). Pass a 1-item array for a single page. Per-item: id (required), optional localeId, and jsonLdSchema (object, raw string, or null to clear). The action also accepts strings wrapped in <script type="application/ld+json">…</script>.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

page_id.description: Unique identifier for the page to create a branch from.

create_branch.description: Enqueue an asynchronous task to create a new branch from a page on a site.

anyOf.description: Run create_branch: Enqueue an asynchronous task to create a new branch from a page on a site.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site to create the page in. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

slug.description: URL slug for the page (the path segment). Required.

parentFolderId.description: ID of the folder to nest the page under. Omit to create the page at the site root.

draft.description: Whether the page is a draft (excluded from publishing). Defaults to false when omitted.

duplicateOf.description: ID of an existing page in the same site to duplicate. When set, the new page is created as a copy of that page.

titleCopied.description: Whether the Open Graph title is copied from the SEO/page title.

descriptionCopied.description: Whether the Open Graph description is copied from the SEO/page description.

imageUrl.description: Raw Open Graph image URL (og:image). null unsets the image. Mutually exclusive with imageAssetId — provide at most one.

imageAssetId.description: Site asset ID to use as the Open Graph image. null unsets the image. Mutually exclusive with imageUrl — provide at most one.

openGraph.description: Open Graph metadata for the page.

create_page.description: Creates a new page in a site (write/side-effect: this adds a new page). title and slug are required; everything else is optional. Optionally place the page under a folder, mark it as a draft, duplicate an existing page in the same site, and set SEO and Open Graph metadata. For openGraph, imageUrl and imageAssetId are mutually exclusive (provide at most one); passing null for either unsets it. parentFolderId places the page under a folder; omit it to create the page at the site root.

anyOf.description: Run create_page: Creates a new page in a site (write/side-effect: this adds a new page). title and slug are required; everything else is optional. Optionally place the page under a folder, mark it as a draft, duplicate an existing page in the same site, and set SEO and Open Graph metadata. For openGraph, imageUrl and imageAssetId are mutually exclusive (provide at most one); passing null for either unsets it. parentFolderId places the page under a folder; omit it to create the page at the site root.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

branch_id.description: Unique identifier for the branch to delete.

delete_branch.description: Enqueue an asynchronous task to delete a branch from a site.

anyOf.description: Run delete_branch: Enqueue an asynchronous task to delete a branch from a site.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (max 100).

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

get_branch_details.description: Get detailed information about a specific branch on a site.

anyOf.description: Run get_branch_details: Get detailed information about a specific branch on a site.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

get_page_metadata.description: Get metadata for a specific page including SEO settings, Open Graph data, and page status (draft/published).

anyOf.description: Run get_page_metadata: Get metadata for a specific page including SEO settings, Open Graph data, and page status (draft/published).

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

limit.description: Maximum number of branches to return (max 100).

offset.description: Number of branches to skip for pagination.

list_branches.description: List all branches present on a site. Returns branch metadata with pagination support.

anyOf.description: Run list_branches: List all branches present on a site. Returns branch metadata with pagination support.

site_id.description: The site's unique ID, used to list its pages.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

list_pages.description: List all pages within a site. Returns page metadata including IDs, titles, and slugs.

anyOf.description: Run list_pages: List all pages within a site. Returns page metadata including IDs, titles, and slugs.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

localeId.description: Secondary locale ID. Omit for the primary locale.

query_pages_schema_markup.description: Read JSON-LD schema markup for one or more pages (1..100). Pass a 1-item array for a single page. Each item may specify localeId for a secondary locale override; omit for the primary locale.

anyOf.description: Run query_pages_schema_markup: Read JSON-LD schema markup for one or more pages (1..100). Pass a 1-item array for a single page. Each item may specify localeId for a secondary locale override; omit for the primary locale.

page_id.description: Unique identifier for the page to update.

localeId.description: Secondary locale ID to write the changes to. Omit for the primary locale.

slug.description: URL slug for the page (the path segment).

draft.description: Whether the page is a draft (excluded from publishing).

parentFolderId.description: ID of the folder to nest the page under. null moves the page to the site root.

titleCopied.description: Whether the Open Graph title is copied from the SEO/page title.

descriptionCopied.description: Whether the Open Graph description is copied from the SEO/page description.

imageUrl.description: Raw Open Graph image URL (og:image). null unsets the image. Mutually exclusive with imageAssetId — provide at most one.

imageAssetId.description: Site asset ID to use as the Open Graph image. null unsets the image. Mutually exclusive with imageUrl — provide at most one.

openGraph.description: Open Graph metadata for the page.

jsonLdSchema.description: JSON-LD structured data as a raw string. null clears the page's existing JSON-LD schema markup.

update_page_settings.description: Updates settings for a single page (write/side-effect: this updates an existing page). Accepts any subset of: title, slug, draft (publishing status), parentFolderId, seo, openGraph, and jsonLdSchema. Pass localeId to write the changes to a specific secondary locale; omit it for the primary locale. parentFolderId nests the page under a folder; null moves it to the site root. For openGraph, imageUrl and imageAssetId are mutually exclusive (provide at most one); passing null for either unsets it. jsonLdSchema null clears the page's JSON-LD schema markup.

anyOf.description: Run update_page_settings: Updates settings for a single page (write/side-effect: this updates an existing page). Accepts any subset of: title, slug, draft (publishing status), parentFolderId, seo, openGraph, and jsonLdSchema. Pass localeId to write the changes to a specific secondary locale; omit it for the primary locale. parentFolderId nests the page under a folder; null moves it to the site root. For openGraph, imageUrl and imageAssetId are mutually exclusive (provide at most one); passing null for either unsets it. jsonLdSchema null clears the page's JSON-LD schema markup.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: bulk_update_pages, bulk_update_pages_schema_markup, create_branch, create_page, delete_branch, get_branch_details, get_page_metadata, list_branches, list_pages, query_pages_schema_markup, update_page_settings.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
